title: Binary Cube Encryption Laboratory Tool Projection
description: Portable structured-tool projection for the Binary Cube laboratory. It describes calls into the canonical adapter/engine and does not implement encryption logic or provide a remote RPC service.

protocolMappings.openaiFunctionTools: Expose each entry in tools as a function tool using its name, description, and inputSchema; bind execution to the named adapter method.
protocolMappings.mcp: Expose each entry in tools as an MCP tool using inputSchema; bind execution locally to the named adapter method. This descriptor is not itself an MCP server.
protocolMappings.genericJsonTool: Use the tool name and inputSchema, then dispatch to binding.method on binary-cube-node-adapter.js.

tools.name: binary_cube_describe
tools.description: Describe the Binary Cube laboratory, runtime, security classification, discovery facilities, high-level workflows, and callable operation names.

tools.name: binary_cube_list_operations
tools.description: List every low-level callable Binary Cube operation together with its canonical positional arguments and return contract.

tools.name: binary_cube_operation_contract
tools.description: Return the canonical argument and return contract for one low-level Binary Cube operation before constructing an invocation.

tools.name: binary_cube_invoke
tools.description: Invoke one documented low-level Binary Cube operation through the canonical adapter.

args.description: Positional arguments in canonical contract order.

tools.name: binary_cube_encrypt
tools.description: High-level common workflow: validate or create a key, encrypt a binary payload, validate the resulting canonical package, and return the separate key and package.

bits.description: Binary payload containing 0/1 characters; whitespace is ignored.

key.description: Optional existing canonical key. If omitted, keyOptions are used to create one.

keyOptions.description: Canonical createKey options, used only when key is omitted.

tools.name: binary_cube_decrypt
tools.description: High-level common workflow: validate a separate canonical key and encrypted package, decrypt them through the canonical engine, and return recovered bits.

tools.name: binary_cube_self_test
tools.description: Run the deterministic Binary Cube portable acceptance tests in the current Node/CommonJS host and return structured pass/fail evidence.

adoption.notes: Prefer high-level encrypt/decrypt workflows for ordinary use. Use low-level invoke for research and diagnostics. Hosts should not claim readiness until binary_cube_self_test succeeds in that host.
